description: Samsite demo — stand a fresh session up end-to-end: seed the plugin GRIFT (AWS/GitHub/KSI/samsite pages + schedules), then fire the collectors that pull the live world in. Seed order is INSTALLED_APPS order; collector order matters: samsite-compliance reads aws_account nodes (boto3) AND content-matches github_workflow nodes (github_core), so both must run before it.

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.administrivia), 2026-07-01. TAP admin pages + grid landing + cares administrivia; seeded in population.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.lotr), 2026-07-01. Load-bearing test-fixture vocabulary the core tap_grid/tap_api suites import; installed here so any env that boots samsite has it importable. Its Middle-earth seed is kept for parity with the bash spawn (safe to drop from a customer profile).
Package-mode (tap_plugin.computing_core), 2026-07-01. Vendor-neutral computing-primitive dimension; seeded in population.
Package-mode (tap_plugin.roscale), 2026-07-01. Install-only: registers the OSCAL workbench panel types samsite's compliance pages consume; no grift seed, no collector, so it is not a population step.
Package-mode (tap_plugin.aws_core), 2026-07-01. Tier-0 boto3 dep (uv resolves at install). AWS dimension + the boto3 collector; seeded in population + its collector fired.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.sigstore_core), 2026-07-01. Tier-0 sigstore dep. Install-only library plugin: samsite's compliance_collector consumes its verify/decompose helpers + models; no grift seed / no collector of its own.
Package-mode (tap_plugin.github_core), 2026-07-01. Carries a Tier-0 PyYAML dep (uv resolves it at install). Editable local source during the monorepo transition.
First plugin migrated to package-mode (tap_plugin.fedramp_20x_ksi), 2026-07-01. Editable local source during the monorepo transition; a real deployment uses a git source pinned to a rev.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.samsite), 2026-07-01. Last of the samsite set to migrate; the demo integration surface. DEPENDS ON the four plugins above at import time (compliance_collector + panels import tap_plugin.{sigstore_core,github_core,roscale} and read aws_core nodes) — listed last so its cross-plugin (Tier-1/2) deps are installed first. The manifest depends_on schema + boot consistency gate that would enforce this are deferred (declare-now, resolver-later); today the ordering here satisfies it structurally.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.grid_fixtures). Install-only: the neutral grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary the core suites + the Gryphon playground build fixtures from. No GRIFT seed, no cross-plugin deps. Listed before gryphon_playground, which depends_on it.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.gryphon_playground), 2026-07-02. Install-only: the Gridkin scenario corpus + harness for the Gryphon test suites. Owns no vocabulary — depends_on grid_fixtures (installed above), whose grid_fixtures__* types its corpus references by string. Declared here so the pre-boot reconciliation guard passes on the session container (which boots this profile); no GRIFT population seed.

steps.note: TAP admin pages + grid landing + cares administrivia.
Middle-earth test-fixture vocabulary/data (kept for parity with the bash spawn; safe to drop from a customer profile).
AWS dimension + region reference data the boto3 collector lands resources into.
Samsite keystone, landing + compliance pages, per-type viewers, and the collector schedules.
FedRAMP 20x KSI dimension, catalog seed, compliance/profile pages, schedule.
AWS resource graph (Route53/CloudFront/S3/Lambda/IAM/...) + the aws_account node the boundary membership depends on. A full multi-region pull can run well past the 90s default.
GitHub repository / Actions data behind the repo landing page.
Refresh the FedRAMP 20x KSI catalog (HTTPS, no credentials).

Signed /.well-known/ compliance artifacts (OSCAL SSP/POA&M, KSI signal, VDR). Fetches 5 artifacts + verifies sigstore signatures, so it gets a generous timeout. MUST run after boto3 (synthesizes SCOPED_TO_BOUNDARY membership from the aws_account nodes) AND after github_core (sigstore_link resolves the signing github_workflow by content-match; if the workflow node isn't on the grid yet those edges are silently omitted).
